tasks.ChangeOfSurroundings: Experience a different setting which can be beneficial for personal growth and relaxation.
tasks.LookAround: Explore the new place by observing and interacting with the environment and people.
tasks.NewExperience: Engage in activities that are novel or unique to the new place.
tasks.TakePictures: Capture images of interesting sights or moments to remember the experience.

answer: When in a new place, you can explore by looking around (b), take pictures of interesting sights or moments to remember the experience (c), change surroundings for personal growth and relaxation (d), or engage in new experiences that are unique to the location (e). The appropriate action depends on your interests: if you find something interesting while exploring, you might want to take a picture; if you're looking for a change of scenery, you can explore different areas; if you enjoy novel activities, you can try them out. Once all pictures are taken or you feel satisfied with the surroundings/new experiences, the sequence ends.
